bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6. POISED was produced for the second time since a stable change when her Coonabarabran effort was solid last start. A repeat performance would make her suitably placed today. MEGA PIXEL kept trying after he struck traffic problems at Warren and he has scope to improve when he presents for the second time since a stable change, making a Gilgandra debut today. EUPHORIC MISS wasn't disgraced at Tamworth when a gear change was made (tongue tie off). That gear change has now been reversed! LONG TIME LOVERS can be forgiven for unplaced recent efforts when she presents after a freshen-up today. She did perform honestly on this track when she was last produced here.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 4, 7, 12. HARD CHOICE begins his second campaign today. He opened his account at Wellington at his most recent start before his spell when he beat a next start winner on the day. He can play a prominent part in the finish of this race without causing any surprises, aided by the claim for Nick Palmer. BLUE BIDDY overcame problems to score on debut at Narromine before she wasn't disgraced last start at Warren. This race is now within her reach. BEAUNIFIED should be treated with respect when he makes his Gilgandra debut this afternoon. He has a good record record behind him over this very short journey. ANGIE'S SISTER has scope to improve third up when she can appreciate a drop in class today.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 5, 6, 7. LADY GIOVANNA overcame an unsuitable run in transit to score first up at Cowra with Jacob Stiff aboard. She should already have more to offer with Jacob retaining the ride today. RIVALDO makes a Gilgandra debut as a last start picnic meeting winner and with a slight step up from 1000m now a plus. READY FOR LIFT OFF wasn't disgraced when he was produced after a very quick back-up at Dubbo last start and he can regain his very best form after this much longer break between starts this afternoon. ELDERBERRY WINE performed well above market place expectations third up and after she had been kept fresh at Cowra with gear changes made. She presents fresh again today.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 4, 8, 10, 11. MYSTERY LAD has finished unplaced at both Tamworth outings since his nine week break. There were however excuses at his home base on both occasions, he is proven away from home and he is ready to make his Gilgandra debut this afternoon when he steps back up in distance. ALPINE ROSE returns to her home track second up and she will do so with scope to improve after enduring too tough a run in transit when she was resuming at Dubbo. CASTLEBAR ROAD had too much to do at Tamworth last start and he's another who will be better suited over this longer journey today, when he will be aided by the claim for Gabrielle Johnston. SHAGGY ROGERS has been given a freshen-up and a stable change since he was outclassed last start at Tamworth. He's better suited here at his home base today.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 6, 7, 14, 15. SUNDAY had not been to the races (or the trials) for one month before she performed well above market place expectations last start at Dubbo. She is proven off a quicker back-up and this race is within her reach. PHILS COLOURS was solid second up at Cowra and he can now be expected to cope with a distance rise from 1400m, aided by the claim for Jacob Stiff. MY ANGEL SHELL did all but win over this trip at Coonabarabran with Gabrielle Johnston aboard and he can maintain his form here with Gabrielle retaining the ride.  SNOW DOG did enough over this journey at Warren last start to suggest that he is now more than ready to make his Gilgandra debut.
